page_title: PAR 1-0 PIS | Parma v Pisa 25/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Good clearance! Emanuele Valeri (Parma) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
90+2' The ball is behind the sideline. Pontus Almqvist (Parma) takes a throw-in.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
87' Wonderful movement. Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) connects with a cross inside the box and plants a header goalwards, but Adrian Semper makes a superb save.
87' Parma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
82' 1 - 0 Goal! Nesta Elphege (Parma) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
81' Carlos Cuesta decides to make a substitution. Enrico Delprato will be replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
80' Here's the change. Rosen Bozhinov leaves the pitch and Lorran (Pisa) comes on as a substitute.
80' Substitution. Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) on for Ebenezer Akinsanmiro.
78' Carlos Cuesta has decided to make a change. Oliver Sorensen (Parma) replaces Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
78' A substitution has been made. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia goes off and Nahuel Estevez (Parma) comes on.
76' Great touch by Henrik Meister (Pisa) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
75' Parma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
73' Henrik Meister (Pisa) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
67' Parma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' Here comes a substitution. Gabriel Strefezza is given a rest as he is replaced by Nesta Elphege (Parma).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Henrik Meister (Pisa) replaces Filip Stojilkovic.
65' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to substitute Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris and he is replaced by Idrissa Toure (Pisa).
65' Here is a change. Mandela Keita is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Christian Ordonez (Parma).
64' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andrea Calzavara saw the whole situation.
63' Pisa are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
59' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
56' Enrico Delprato (Parma) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
52' The ball goes behind for a corner. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' This shall not pass! Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
49' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
47' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
46' Substitution. Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Isak Vural walks off.
46' Andrea Calzavara blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45+1' Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
45' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
44' Isak Vural (Pisa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Calzavara had an easy-decision to make.
41' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) brings his opponent down. Andrea Calzavara has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.

40' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Adrian Semper was alert and the score remains the same.
38' Enrico Delprato (Parma) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
35' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies miles over the crossbar. Very poor shot.
35' Pisa fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
33' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) is penalised for a foul. Andrea Calzavara had a clear view and blows his whistle.
32' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
31' A corner kick by Parma is thwarted by the well prepared Adrian Semper (Pisa).
29' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the right post.
28' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
28' Pisa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
25' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) trips an opposition player and Andrea Calzavara signals a foul.

22' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
21' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) tries his luck with a promising long-range shot from a rebound, but the ball sails painfully wide of the left post. What a great effort!
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) was quite harsh and Andrea Calzavara didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' A quickly taken corner by Pisa.
15' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
15' Parma fail to score from a corner as Adrian Semper (Pisa) leaps to collect the ball.
14' Alessandro Circati (Parma) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
14' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Gabriel Strefezza (Parma). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
13' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
13' The Parma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
11' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

9' Mandela Keita (Parma) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom left corner, but Adrian Semper made a superb athletic save to deny him.
8' The corner is swung in but Pisa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
6' Isak Vural (Pisa) is obviously very disappointed with his shot from the rebound. He aims exactly at the goalkeeper's gloves. This should have been an easy goal!
3' Andrea Calzavara blows his whistle and signals a foul after Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) brought his opponent down.
2' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Pisa will have the kick-off.
Andrea Calzavara will officiate today.
